name: canva
label: Canva
description: Create, export and organize Canva designs and assets

oauth2.scope: design:content:read design:content:write design:meta:read asset:read asset:write folder:read folder:write profile:read

create_design.label: Create Design
create_design.description: Create a new Canva design from a preset type or custom size. Blank designs are deleted by Canva if not edited within 7 days.

designTypeOption.label: Design Type
designTypeOption.description: Choose a preset design type or custom dimensions.

presetName.label: Preset Design Type
presetName.description: Used when Design Type is Preset.

customWidth.label: Custom Width (pixels)
customWidth.description: Used when Design Type is Custom size. 40-8000. Width x height must not exceed 25,000,000.

customHeight.label: Custom Height (pixels)
customHeight.description: Used when Design Type is Custom size. 40-8000.

title.label: Design Title
title.description: Optional name for the design (1-255 characters). Canva picks one if empty.

assetId.label: Image Asset
assetId.description: Optional image from your Canva library to add to the design.

get_design.label: Get Design
get_design.description: Get the details of a design, including owner, edit and view links, and thumbnail.

designId.label: Design
designId.description: The design to look up. Type to search.

get_folder.label: Get Folder
get_folder.description: Get the details of a folder, including name, dates and thumbnail.

get_asset.label: Get Asset
get_asset.description: Get the details of an image or video in your Canva library, including name, tags, dates and thumbnail.

create_folder.label: Create Folder
create_folder.description: Create a folder in your Canva projects, in Uploads, or inside another folder.

name.label: Folder Name
name.description: Name of the new folder (1-255 characters).

canva_get_design.label: Get Design
canva_get_design.description: Gets one Canva design by ID.

canva_get_export_job.label: Get Export Job
canva_get_export_job.description: Get Export Job by job ID.

jobId.label: Job ID
jobId.description: The job_id returned when the job was started.

canva_get_asset_upload_job.label: Get Asset Upload Job
canva_get_asset_upload_job.description: Get Asset Upload Job by job ID.

jobId.label: Job ID
jobId.description: The job_id returned when the job was started.

canva_get_import_job.label: Get Import Job
canva_get_import_job.description: Get Import Job by job ID.

jobId.label: Job ID
jobId.description: The job_id returned when the job was started.

parentFolderId.label: Parent Folder ID
parentFolderId.description: root, uploads, or a folder ID.

canva_get_asset.label: Get Asset
canva_get_asset.description: Gets one Canva library asset by ID.

canva_update_asset.label: Update Asset
canva_update_asset.description: Renames a Canva asset or replaces its tags.

name.label: Name
name.description: New name, max 50 characters. Empty leaves it unchanged.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Full replacement list of tags (max 50). Empty leaves tags unchanged.

clearTags.label: Clear Tags
clearTags.description: Remove all tags from the asset.
